transcript.text: Alright everyone, I need to run my standard pre-run review before I can authorize the production plan for the next window. We all know the normal resin shipment is delayed and we have an alternate resin from an existing industrial supplier under consideration. This alternate hasn't been used in this housing line's regular production before, so I need input from each of you. Process engineering: what do we know about this alternate resin's behavior in our process? Materials logistics: what's the supply situation? And customer compliance: are there any concerns with using this alternate against customer specifications? I need your reports before I can make a binding decision on whether we proceed and what controls we put in place.
